title: IAM MFA Device Deactivated Or Deleted
description: Detects deactivation or deletion of IAM MFA devices (DeactivateMFADevice, DeleteVirtualMFADevice). Adds Multi-Factor Authentication modification (T1556.006) coverage beyond the existing SigmaHQ SSO external-IdP change rule.
falsePositives: Legitimate MFA device rotation or lost-device recovery by administrators.
